extracted.stage: early stage, matter not yet costed
extracted.summary: A solicitor is making a preliminary enquiry about funding for a client in matrimonial proceedings with assets of around £651,000, with no loan amount yet costed.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry and for the background on your client's matrimonial matter. To consider it further we would need the amount of funding sought and a costs estimate or budget, confirmation of the jurisdiction in which the proceedings are issued, and details of the stage reached and any listed hearing dates. It would also help to have a breakdown of the assets in dispute and how they are held, together with your client's details for our standard onboarding checks. Once we have those, a member of the team will review the enquiry and come back to you. Please do let us know if you have any questions in the meantime.
